title: Learn - geterdone.io release contract
description: Versioned JSON release contract for the learn-geterdone platform application, as required by platform-ops docs/DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.md section 3 (release metadata contract) and consumed by the root-owned deploy wrapper during staging validation. The wrapper computes this document's own SHA-256 externally (release-contract checksum); it is therefore deliberately not a field of the document.

schema_version.description: Contract schema version. Any change to field meaning, frozen values, or acceptance semantics requires a new version plus re-acceptance.

notes.description: Non-authoritative human notes. Never used for any decision.

items.description: JSON Pointer to a field still carrying an unallocated placeholder.

unallocated.description: Required when placeholders_present is true. Enumerates every field a human must allocate before this contract may be used for a real release.

release_id.description: Immutable release directory name: <40-hex source revision>-<first 12 hex of the image digest>. The wrapper must independently verify that it is exactly source.revision + '-' + first 12 hex of image.digest; JSON Schema cannot express that equality.

slug.description: FROZEN. Must equal the root registry slug for this app once onboarding registers it.

repository.description: FROZEN. Authenticated GitHub repository that produced this release.

revision.description: Exact 40-lowercase-hex commit on protected main. Short SHAs, tags, and branch names are never acceptable.

ref.description: FROZEN. Only protected main may produce a routine release.

repository.description: FROZEN. Registry-returned repository; must match the root registry oci_repository.

digest.description: Registry-returned manifest digest. Never a tag, never a 12-hex prefix.

reference.description: The only deployable image reference. The wrapper must verify it equals image.repository + '@' + image.digest byte for byte.

timestamp.description: UTC build time, RFC 3339 with a literal Z. Local offsets are rejected.

source_date_epoch.description: Deterministic build clock passed to the image builder so the digest is reproducible from source.revision.

reference.description: Base image repository without a tag or digest.

digest.description: Pinned base image digest. __BASE_IMAGE_DIGEST__ marks a digest that has NOT been verified against a registry; a fabricated sha256 is a contract violation.

reproducible.description: True only when the same source.revision and source_date_epoch were built twice and produced the identical image digest.

tmpfs.description: Bounded tmpfs mounts only. Unbounded or host-path mounts are rejected.

class.description: The already-onboarded shared private edge network.

internal_port.description: The in-container HTTP port served by Caddy.

shared_network.description: External shared network managed by the platform host.

private_ipv4.description: Fixed private address assigned by the platform host.

path.description: FROZEN. Served by the in-container web server; must match the root registry health path.

canonical.description: FROZEN. The apex geterdone.io is a separate live GitHub Pages site owned elsewhere and is out of scope for this app.

all.description: Every public hostname this app claims. Claiming the apex or its www alias is rejected: they belong to a separate site this platform does not control.

protected_neighbors.description: Public endpoints of other tenants on the same host. Each must stay healthy and identity-stable across the release window; drift fails acceptance and rolls back only this app.

deadline_seconds.description: Total wall-clock ceiling for the whole acceptance matrix after app recreation. Retries never reset it.

checks.description: The complete blocking acceptance matrix: the platform checks, plus one check per published URL of the library - the site index at / (id learn-index), the path page at /paths/trading/ (id trading-path), a home per course (/market-structure/ id course-home, /trade-setup-execution/ id course2-home, /options-trading/ id course3-home, /technical-indicators/ id course4-home, /volume-and-order-flow/ id course5-home, /trading-risk-management/ id course6-home, /backtesting-and-trading-systems/ id course7-home, /algorithmic-and-automated-trading/ id course8-home), each course's lessons beneath its own home (course 1 lab 01 keeps the id lesson-page; the ids of courses 2 to 8 are course-scoped because a slug is unique only within a course - course 2 and course 6 both ship a position-sizing lesson), and the eight published non-HTML assets, /trade-setup-execution/trade-journal-schema.json (id journal-schema), /options-trading/options-trade-plan-schema.json (id trade-plan-schema), /technical-indicators/indicator-rule-schema.json (id indicator-rule-schema), /volume-and-order-flow/volume-order-flow-rule-schema.json (id volume-order-flow-rule-schema), /trading-risk-management/trading-risk-plan-schema.json (id trading-risk-plan-schema), /backtesting-and-trading-systems/trading-system-specification-schema.json (id trading-system-specification-schema) /algorithmic-and-automated-trading/automated-trading-system-schema.json (id automated-trading-system-schema) and the capstone's dataset /paths/trading/iren-analysis-2026-08-16/iren-analysis-data.json (id capstone-iren-dataset, not a schema but the data the capstone's figures derive from), each of which is fetched and PARSED rather than asserted against page-shaped markers. Beside the course tree the path publishes the dated real-data CAPSTONE at /paths/trading/iren-analysis-2026-08-16/ (id capstone-iren-lab) and its slide deck (id capstone-iren-slides). That is 130 pages and 8 assets: the trading path is COMPLETE at eight courses and the capstone is a worked example rather than a ninth, so this list stops growing until a second path is published. The two capstone pages are the only published pages built from REAL market data, so their checks demand the real-data notice and the AS-OF DATE in place of the synthetic-examples disclaimer that would be false on them - a stricter requirement, declared by name here and in tests/test_site_invariants.py (REAL_DATA_PAGES), never a page exempted from being checked. The path page is neither a course home nor a lesson and is checked as itself: it is the only published URL that shows the WHOLE path in one place, and its markers name the LAST course on the path and the link to its home - they used to name the first announced course instead, which is a state this path can no longer be in. Every id below is REQUIRED to be present: minItems alone would let a check be swapped out for another. The retired flat /<lesson>/ URLs and course 1's retired /market-structure-lab/ prefix have no checks because they have no pages. scripts/smoke.py implements the same check ids; a green HTTP 200 alone is never acceptance.

artifact_name.description: Non-secret workflow artifact that carries the redacted transcript and result. Never a secret destination.

invocation.description: Delivery/audit identity. It distinguishes executions and never changes release content identity.

placeholders_present.description: True while any __PLACEHOLDER__ remains. A release gate must refuse to deploy a contract whose value is true.

allOf.$comment: A draft with placeholders must list the fields still needing allocation.
A deployable contract has no placeholders or stale unallocated list.

then.description: A deployable contract carries no placeholders: the human-allocated loopback port, the internal port rendered to that same integer, the subnet, and every base image digest must all be real values, and a stale unallocated list may not survive alongside the claim.

allOf.description: A deployable contract carries no unresolved placeholders and no unallocated list.

id.description: Stable check id, reported verbatim by scripts/smoke.py. A lesson check is course-scoped and carries the lesson's own URL slug, so its length is fixed by the published URL and not by this document: the longest declared id is course7-lesson-overfitting-sensitivity-monte-carlo-and-stress-testing at 69 characters, which is why the bound is 72 rather than the 64 that fitted courses 1 to 6. Course 8 lesson 16 is the one slug that does NOT fit - course8-lesson- plus automated-trading-system-specification-and-production-readiness is 78 - so scripts/smoke.py shortens that ONE id to course8-lesson-system-specification-and-production-readiness and the contract declares it under the same name; the bound is not raised to accommodate a slug, and a shortened id is written down in both files rather than derived differently in each. The bound is on formatting only - the allOf list on acceptance.checks still names every required id, and no check can be dropped or swapped for another under any length.

scope.description: container = engine healthcheck on the shared-private-edge address; private = 10.89.2.22:8080; public = canonical HTTPS through the shared edge.

blocking.description: There is no warning-only acceptance check. Every check blocks.

no_external_origins.description: When true, the served document must reference no origin other than its own; only data: URIs and non-fetching XML namespaces are exempt.
